derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of the same as G4476 (ῥαφίς);
def: unsewed, i.e. of a single piece

occurrences.text: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
